> [!CAUTION]
> If this vulnerability affects active production systems or exposes user data, please **DO NOT** file a public issue.
> Report it privately to `security@openagent.org` or through GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting according to [SECURITY.md](../../SECURITY.md).

**Vulnerability Summary**
High-level description of the potential vulnerability.

**Affected Component**

- [ ] Core Policy Engine / Executor
- [ ] Cryptographic Identity / Network Authenticator
- [ ] Hybrid Vector Storage
- [ ] Graph RAG Engine
- [ ] Local API Server / IPC
- [ ] Desktop Vault / Backup Engine
- [ ] Other

**Threat Model / Impact**
Describe the impact (e.g. privilege escalation, policy bypass, path traversal, replay attack).

**Proof of Concept (PoC)**
Steps to reproduce in an isolated environment.
